definitions.explanation: A detailed drawing or plan showing the design and specifications of a building, machine, or other structure. Also used figuratively to mean a master plan or overall design for something.

examples.japanese: {設計図|せっけいず}を{引|ひ}く。
{建築家|けんちくか}が{新|あたら}しい{家|いえ}の{設計図|せっけいず}を{見|み}せてくれた。
examples.english: The architect showed us the blueprints for the new house.

examples.japanese: DNAは{生命|せいめい}の{設計図|せっけいず}と{呼|よ}ばれている。
examples.english: DNA is called the blueprint of life.

notes:
Composed of {設計|せっけい} (design, engineering) and {図|ず} (drawing, diagram).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設計図|せっけいず}を{引|ひ}く (to draw blueprints)
- {設計図|せっけいず}を{描|えが}く (to draft a design plan)
- {設計図|せっけいず}{通|どお}りに{作|つく}る (to build according to the blueprints)
- {人生|じんせい}の{設計図|せっけいず} (blueprint for one's life)

USAGE NOTE:
The figurative use comparing something to a blueprint is common, especially in science ({生命|せいめい}の{設計図|せっけいず} for DNA) and self-help contexts ({人生|じんせい}の{設計図|せっけいず} for a life plan).
